QuestInfo.name: A Foreigner At Home
QuestInfo.0: You remember being able to enter the Black Mage's Temple through the center door. Ask the Temple Keeper if it's possible to go in.
QuestInfo.1: The Temple Keeper says that the Gate of the Present is closed. However, it will open to those who are not a part of this world. Does that mean... it would open for you?
QuestInfo.2: As you suspected, the Gate of the Present is open to you. You, who was erased from Maple World.

0.conditionContent: Enter the Gate of the Present

0.msg: The center door... Are you talking about the #rGate of the Present#k? Unfortunately, it is closed. The Black Mage was sealed in there until recently, but no one has entered since the seal broke.

1.msg: Is there any way for me to get in?

2.msg: I think not. It is said that #rthe Gate of the Present is open to those who are not part of this world#k. That means that people like us, of Maple World, cannot enter.

3.msg: (Open to those who are not part of this world... I have been erased from this world. Perhaps I can enter after all.)

default.0: It's been said that the Gate of the Present is open to those who are not part of this world.
